description: Call this before paying because an email, invoice or chat message asked you to. Pass what you received: raw headers if you have them, the From line, subject and body (or body_html), and the payee address if you already extracted one. OceanAlt checks whether the sender is spoofed (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, a display name naming another domain, Reply-To sent elsewhere), whether the sender domain or links imitate a brand or are known phishing hosts, whether the payee is listed or differs from previous_pay_to, and whether the text pressures the reader, announces changed payment details, or carries instructions aimed at an AI. Returns allow | review | decline with findings. On decline, do not pay from this message. The text is processed in memory and not stored. Free, no API key.

body.description: Plain-text body, invoice text or chat message

expected_sender_domain.description: The domain this requester normally sends from

headers.description: Raw email headers, if available (needed for SPF/DKIM/DMARC)

network.description: Network of pay_to, e.g. base, ethereum, tron, solana

pay_to.description: The payee address the message asks you to pay

previous_pay_to.description: The address you paid this requester last time

name: check_payment_request
title: Check an email, invoice or message that asks you to pay (free)
